enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Vicious: When a vicious weapon strikes an opponent, it creates a flash of disruptive energy that resonates between the opponent and the wielder. This energy deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage to the opponent and 1 to 3 points of damage to the wielder.

Ribcracker III: On Critical Hit: 7 to 42 Bludgeoning damage from weapons with a x2 Critical Multiplier, 7 to 56 Bludgeoning damage from weapons with a x3 Critical Multiplier, and 7 to 70 Bludgeoning damage from weapons with a x4 or greater Critical Multiplier.
